profileLabel: Center-left economics (low confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: South Cotabato 3rd District representative with 166 principal-authored bills. Authored an expanded electricity lifeline rate for minimum-wage earners, institutionalized assistance to individuals in crisis situations and abolition of the travel tax. Co-authored the national minimum wage, cash assistance for first-time employees and a nationwide travel-tax abolition.
caveat: Thin rubric-relevant extraction against a very large portfolio; extractor may under-report. Bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored expanded electricity lifeline rate (-2) and institutionalized crisis assistance (-2); co-authored national minimum wage and cash assistance for first-time employees (-2). Travel-tax abolition is neutral. Three issues, partly co-authored.
